title: A contributor joins
sub: The third film of From helper to colleague, the third series on AI agents in data work: before an agent works alone, it's architected like a colleague, with a place on the map, a role, an owner, rights from its role, someone to ask, a gate it passes and people who may stop it.
howto: The opening is California in 1970, drawn in the module's matte style; the rest is the module's lab, a pale marble wall over an oak floor, light from a window on the right. Each agent is a ceramic sphere with a violet band, never a person, told apart by its name and its badge. Blue is structure (a role, a rule, the map), violet the model, orange the data, green a check that passed or a person's approval, amber what went wrong.
